identity.instance: process PID plus random UUID; renewed on process start

components.name: app

embedded_worker.name: redis_subscriber
embedded_worker.heartbeat: after completed poll/dispatch, including empty polls

components.metrics_secret_reference: existing per-component token if configured, else existing shared METRICS_BEARER_TOKEN or METRICS_TOKEN

components.name: payment-worker
components.metrics_secret_reference: existing per-component token if configured, else existing shared METRICS_BEARER_TOKEN or METRICS_TOKEN

dependencies.name: postgresql
dependencies.probe: read-only selection of telemetry_context from wallet/payments outbox

dependencies.name: redis
dependencies.critical: when PAYMENT_EVENT_TRANSPORT=redis_stream; optional for callback-oriented payment API

dependencies.name: payment_providers
dependencies.probe: none; only actual business calls instrumented

metrics.authentication: existing Bearer preserved; missing token 503; wrong/absent token 401; configured CIDR failure 401; direct socket peer only; Uvicorn proxy header rewriting disabled
metrics.secret_reference: existing central scrape credential file(s); preserve token values, no new secret required
metrics.producer_secret_variable: METRICS_BEARER_TOKEN, alias METRICS_TOKEN; Compose keeps API_METRICS_TOKEN / WORKER_METRICS_TOKEN if already configured, otherwise shared standard/legacy secret
metrics.allowed_source_networks_variable: METRICS_ALLOWED_CIDRS (optional additional allowlist; empty = no IP restriction, Bearer still mandatory)
metrics.transport: existing API ingress unchanged; /internal/metrics on API 8000 and worker 9001; worker has no host publication; confirm routed targets independently of outbound OTLP
metrics.canonical_source: native producer; never add recording aliases duplicating native diddi_* families
metrics.additional_metrics: Existing diddipay_* business metrics and Python runtime metrics retained; never financial source of truth

logs.delivery: best effort, SDK bounded retries; overflow/failures counted; pending records can be lost on crash/deadline
logs.logger_path: payfund propagate=false and root share one idempotent OTLP handler; Uvicorn/Alembic reconfiguration restored; exporter diagnostics excluded to avoid recursion
logs.local_copies: stderr with existing Docker rotation; optional legacy file only for troubleshooting; no central file/Docker collection
logs.sensitive_data: existing JSON redaction before enqueue; no raw exception/exporter diagnostic forwarded
logs.authentication_secret_reference: OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_HEADERS from private central handoff; existing API_/WORKER_ overrides mapped by Compose

traces.generic_endpoint_variable: TRACING_OTLP_ENDPOINT or OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT; appends /v1/traces exactly once
traces.authentication_secret_reference: OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_HEADERS (existing component overrides mapped in Compose)
traces.ca_reference: system public CA store; no private CA/client certificate
traces.public_boundary: central ingress must enforce trusted sampling; not yet validated
traces.memory_budget: bounded item count; conservative 128 MiB telemetry process allowance to validate under real load; local measured peak in evidence/outage.json includes test harness
traces.retry: SDK 1.44 OTLP bounded deadline, exponential backoff/jitter; no durable producer spool; Retry-After honored across batches; OTLP partial rejections counted
traces.delivery: best effort; queue overflow drops oldest, failed exports counted; recovery sends new spans, lost spans not replayed
traces.sanitization: allowlisted method/status/route/messaging metadata; URLs, peer addresses, raw events/status text removed before queue

async.storage: nullable telemetry_context JSONB column in both outboxes
async.policy: new consumer trace per attempt with link to original publication; HTTP client child propagated to callback; Redis stream metadata separate from signed event; inbound Redis PubSub extracts metadata
async.compatibility: signed callback body unchanged; legacy rows without metadata create unlinked spans; consumers outside this repository require coordinated validation

central_values_required: OTLP credentials from private onboarding handoff
actual API/worker scrape URLs and peer CIDRs if filtering desired
approved routing to worker port 9001 without requiring shared platform network

retention_days.backup_exports: central expiration policy required; not implemented here

slo: not defined or approved for v1; legacy example SLO rules are not central policy
not_applicable: No scheduler container or recurring cron jobs declared; next execution/deadline not applicable to continuous worker
Redis Stream consumer backlog: this module publishes only, consumers belong to other modules; its durable delivery backlog is payments_outbox
blocking_external_validation: central POST authentication and real logs/traces receipt
API and worker actual metrics target URLs, firewall and CIDR peers
C10 representative five-minute logs AND traces outage/recovery
C12 central retention/backups/alerts and coordinated legacy collector disable

activation.logs: OTEL_LOGS_ENABLED=true and explicit full logs URL
activation.traces: TRACING_ENABLED=false vetoes export; otherwise configured standard specific/base endpoint required, empty disables; standalone settings default true, Compose default false pending central routes
activation.global: OBSERVABILITY_ENABLED controls application emit() only; no global OTEL_ENABLED switch; libraries controlled by handler
activation.precedence: standard setting names override legacy aliases; component-prefixed Compose values override shared standard value for that component

public_handoff.status: prepared not deployed; no ingestion proof
